youtube.title: Why Beer Bottles Are Brown 🍺 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Beer is often sold in brown glass because hops contain iso-alpha acids that break down in sunlight. Blue and UV light split these compounds, and the fragments react with sulfur compounds to form a skunky-smelling chemical called 3-methyl-2-butene-1-thiol. Brown glass absorbs most of that light, green glass absorbs less, and clear glass almost none.
